title: Turn on paid access
description: Charge for hub access on Aura Library: connect Stripe, enable monetization, set a price, and understand the 5% platform fee plus Stripe processing.
content:
Ready to charge for hub access? This guide walks Connect → enable monetization → price → storefront / paywall, with fees stated once clearly.

Primary action: Hub → Monetization → Connect Stripe (when prompted).

When to use paid access

Paid access is optional. Free hubs stay first-class. Turn it on when you want to charge for access—often after interest shows up.

Overview: Optional earning.

Prerequisites

  • An account and a hub with the content you’re selling.
  • Ready to complete Stripe Connect.
  • Confirmed rights to sell access to everything in the hub—see Content rights.
  • Works on Free and Growth—selling is not Growth-gated. See when to upgrade and Plans for capacity limits, not for whether you can sell.

Step 1 — Connect Stripe

  1. Start Connect from monetization or billing flows in the app.
  2. Finish Connect before you can take charges.
  3. When Connect is charge-ready (charges_enabled), you may show a verified creator check on profile or paywall. That badge is not an Explore ranking boost. See Trust.

Step 2 — Enable monetization on the hub

  1. Open the hub → settings → Monetization (or /monetization/:workspaceId in the app).
  2. Turn monetization on for that hub.

Step 3 — Set price and type

  • One-time (ongoing access after purchase) or monthly subscription.
  • Optional free trial where the product offers it.
  • Prefer clear prices buyers understand (often USD).

Step 4 — Storefront / paywall

  • Use Storefront settings for headline and listing copy buyers see before unlock.
  • Configure peek vs locked content as the product allows.
  • Non-buyers hitting /hub/:id see the paywall until they purchase (or complete a trial where offered).

Fees

Aura Library: 5% platform fee on hub sales processed through Stripe Connect.

Stripe: processing fees apply separately (for example, US card rates are often about 2.9% + $0.30—confirm current rates in Stripe).

Growth does not remove the 5%. Growth is about capacity and support, not a lower marketplace fee.

Aura Library does not hold your funds. Payouts go through Stripe Connect to you.

App legal pages under /legal/… (for example creator monetization) cover terms in the product.

After someone buys

  • The buyer gets access after successful checkout (and trial rules if you offered one).
  • Payouts are handled by Stripe.
  • Track purchasers and views in hub Analytics; detailed dollars live in the Stripe Dashboard. Guide: Analytics for creators.

Adult + paid

Adult hubs still require login and age verification (date of birth, 18+) for buyers—even when monetized. See Adult content & age verification and Trust.

Quick facts

  • Payment types: one-time or monthly.
  • Free can sell: yes, with Stripe Connect.
  • Take rate: 5% (+ Stripe processing).
  • Access: granted after successful checkout (and trial rules if used).
  • Badge: charge-ready Connect—not Explore ranking.

What’s next

  • Content rights — you must have rights to sell access.
  • List a hub on Explore if it isn’t listed yet.
  • Your profile & sharing — share your storefront link.
  • Share with customers: Buying & access.
  • Still setting up a hub? Get started (creators).

Open the app → Monetization
